summary: Iteration 6: SSE real-time events, plug-and-play email service, auto-delivery-agent-assignment, base_pincode field, and AWS deployment readme tested. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass. Frontend: Admin Orders Dashboard renders with Base Pincode field in Add Delivery Agent modal; MyOrdersPage no longer redirects (auth loading guard works); OrderTrackingPage timeline renders & opens SSE connection; BakeryNavbar bell present and opens SSE connection. No critical issues found in this iteration.

minor.issue: Carry-over from iteration 5: still uses session['expires_at'] which raises KeyError -> 500 if any user_sessions doc lacks expires_at. Use session.get('expires_at'). Not directly hit in iter6 tests but flagged for hygiene.
Manual reassignment does NOT decrement active_orders accounting because count is computed live from order statuses; harmless but worth knowing. Not a bug.

verified_working: GET /api/sse/events?token=<valid> -> 200 text/event-stream, emits 'connected' event with user_id
GET /api/sse/events with Authorization: Bearer <token> works (cookie/query/header all supported)
email_service.get_email_provider() returns None when EMAIL_PROVIDER env is empty
email_service.send_email() returns False gracefully and logs 'Email skipped (no provider configured)'
GET /api/order-management/delivery-agents returns agents with base_pincode and active_orders fields
PUT /api/order-management/users/{user_id}/make-delivery-agent accepts and persists base_pincode field
PUT /api/order-management/orders/{order_id}/status with status=confirmed triggers asyncio auto_assign_delivery_agent; order.delivery_agent_id populated within ~3s
Auto-assign sends 'delivery_assignment' notification to assigned agent (verified via GET /notifications as delivery user)
/app/AWS_DEPLOYMENT_README.md exists with S3, CloudFront, ECS, MongoDB Atlas, EMAIL_PROVIDER sections

Frontend /admin/orders renders Order Management page, stats cards, filter buttons, delivery agent bar, and Add Delivery Agent modal containing 'BASE PINCODE (for auto-assignment)' input alongside email & phone
Frontend /my-orders no longer redirects; loads as customer with notification bell visible (unread=1) and SSE connection initiated

Frontend /track/ord_d6b06a5a6b26 renders vertical timeline (Order Placed -> Confirmed [CURRENT] -> Preparing -> On The Way -> Reached Doorstep -> Delivered) and Order Details with line items and totals
BakeryNavbar opens SSE stream to /api/sse/events?token=<session_token> on mount (request observed in network capture). Same SSE call repeats on tracking page (component-level subscription)
action_items: (Carry-over) FIX (LOW): server.py get_current_user should use session.get('expires_at') to avoid KeyError on malformed sessions

Consider deduplicating multiple SSE connections per tab: BakeryNavbar opens one, OrderTrackingPage opens another. Two open EventSources per page is wasteful — share a single SSE connection via context or a singleton hook.
Consider closing previous EventSource on route change to avoid leaks (verify via long-lived testing).
critical_code_review_comments: sse_routes.py _subscribers is process-local: in multi-worker deployment (e.g., uvicorn --workers 4 as in AWS_DEPLOYMENT_README.md), events published on one worker will not reach subscribers on other workers. For production at scale, swap in Redis pub/sub or NATS. Currently OK for single-worker.

sse_routes.py _get_user_from_request does not validate session expires_at — any session_token row matches even if expired. Use the same guard as server.py get_current_user (after that endpoint is fixed).

order_management_routes.py: auto_assign_delivery_agent uses asyncio.create_task without awaiting; exceptions inside the task will be silently swallowed. Add a logger.exception in a try/except for observability.
Pincode proximity uses prefix length, not actual distance; works only within same district. Document this limitation in the auto-assign comment.

email_service.ResendProvider imports 'resend' lazily but is not in requirements.txt — when EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend is set without installing resend package, ImportError raises mid-send. Either add provider deps to requirements.txt or fail fast at get_email_provider() time with a clear message.
AWS README is well-structured and pragmatic; no issues found.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 flows: admin dashboard with pincode field, my-orders no-redirect, order tracking with SSE)

test_credentials: Same as iter5: admin=test_session_admin_001, customer=test_session_customer_001, delivery=test_session_delivery_001 (user_fb1a35e23da7). All read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Delivery agent base_pincode updated to '400001' via PUT make-delivery-agent. One pending order was confirmed during testing which triggered auto-assignment (added to existing assignments on delivery agent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 features are working end-to-end. Email service is intentionally disabled (EMAIL_PROVIDER env is empty) so emails are skipped — to activate, set EMAIL_PROVIDER + EMAIL_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env and restart backend. Auto-assign and SSE work in single-worker setup; for multi-worker, would need Redis pub/sub. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_sse_email_autoassign.py covers SSE, email skip, auto-assign, base_pincode.
